title: [finding] AGENTS.md's commit-trailer sentence is self-ambiguous: it prescribes the "model-free trailer pair" and in the same breath exempts "the harness-written Co-Authored-By trailer" — which carries a model name, so two seats read it two ways and objectui main now holds both shapes
body:
Moved from **objectstack-ai/objectui#8471** by the triage seat (`claude-opus-5`). That card was filed in objectui, but ⛔ no objectui file is proposed for change by it and the governing text lives entirely here — so under the file-at-destination rule it is rebuilt here and the source is closed as moved. All measurements below are the objectui seats'; the sharper diagnosis in **"What the original card did not have"** is the triage seat's and is flagged as such.

## The instruction, verbatim from `AGENTS.md` (`origin/main 094b8fd9`, ~`:440-444`)

> **Commit message:** an agent commit ends with the **model-free trailer pair**
> `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_<id>` and
> `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>`; no model identifier lands in a PR title or
> body, a comment, a changeset, a doc or a code comment — **the harness-written `Co-Authored-By`
> trailer (with its session link) is the one exemption.**

And in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md:215-217`:

> - 模型标识只禁**内容工件**:PR 标题与正文、代码注释、文档、changeset、评论。
> - 两条豁免同属规则,⛔ **不再申报为偏差**:一是 commit 的 `Co-Authored-By` 尾注(含 session 链接)。
> - 另一条是 `.claude/agents/*` frontmatter 的 `model:`,`check:agent-model-declared` 要求。

## ⭐ What the original card did not have — the collision is INSIDE one sentence

objectui#8471 framed this as *harness template vs. the `os-dev` dispatch ban* — two external sources with different owners, hence "no wording satisfies both". ⚠️ Reading the governing text in full, that framing understates it. `AGENTS.md`'s own sentence gives two readings:

- **Reading A — the prescription.** It names the required form and calls it the *model-free* trailer pair, spelling it out as `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>`. ⇒ write it model-free.
- **Reading B — the exemption clause.** *"the harness-written `Co-Authored-By` trailer … is the one exemption"* — the harness's trailer is exempt, and the harness's trailer carries a model name. ⇒ keep what the harness emitted.

**Both readings are of the same sentence, and they prescribe different bytes.** ⇒ This is not two owners disagreeing; it is one governed sentence that does not decide. That is why it cannot be resolved by a seat picking the "stricter" source — there is no second source to defer to.

⭐ **The runbook line is the tie-breaker, and it points at Reading A.** `:216` says the exemption means ⛔ *不再申报为偏差* — no longer **declared as a deviation**. That is a **reporting** exemption (don't file a deviation when the harness emits its own trailer), ⛔ not a licence to emit a model identifier. Under that reading the two texts agree and the answer is determinate. ⇒ **The repair is to make `AGENTS.md` say that explicitly**, not to choose a winner between owners.

## Measured — it is at `main` now, not hypothetical (objectui seat, `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, 2026-09-08T01:50Z)

objectui PR #8461 merged 01:26:49Z as `c90395b20`; its squashed message ends:

```
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr
---------
Co-authored-by: claude[bot] <209825114+claude[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```

⇒ A model identifier is in permanent history, **twice in one commit**, in a machine-readable trailer field.

⭐ **And the divergence is observed, not forecast.** Two `os-dev` seats dispatched by the same PM session an hour apart resolved it two ways: #8461's seat followed the harness template (above); #8467's seat wrote the model-free form and filed the card rather than choosing silently. objectui `main` therefore carries **both shapes**.

⚠️ **A correction the objectui seat recorded against itself**, quoted because it explains why this ran unchecked: that seat had asserted all shift that *"squash normalises trailers to plain `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` … so the dispatch fence and the mandated trailer never collide at `main`."* The commit above falsifies it. The belief was carried forward without being re-taken. ⇒ The ⛔ ban in the dispatch briefs was **not** redundant; it was the only thing between the two readings, and it held in exactly one seat of two.

## Why it is worth a card

- ⚠️ It fires on **every commit of every dispatch** — the highest possible frequency, and each seat resolves it independently.
- ⚠️ The result is **inconsistent bytes in a machine-readable field**; anything that groups commits by co-author gets more than one shape for one author.
- ⭐ The failure is silent in the dangerous direction: a seat that follows the harness template gets no error at all.
- ⚠️ **History is not rewritable**, so no repair cleans up what has already landed. Any option that leaves both shapes in place should **say so** rather than imply a uniform field.

## Scope of the repair, ⛔ stated as sites rather than as prescribed wording

Whichever reading is made canonical, it must land in every place that states the rule, or the collision is recreated:

- `AGENTS.md` — the sentence above (the ambiguity itself);
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md:216` — the deviation-reporting exemption;
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — the dispatch contract the dev actually reads.

⚠️ **Same class as #16807** (the `## 验收备注` heading collision): a rule stated in more than one place, where the copies do not agree and each seat resolves it alone. Worth handling by the same person, in the same pass.

## Not answered here

- Whether the intended answer is Reading A or Reading B. ⛔ The triage seat reads the runbook as settling it for A, but ⛔ does not rule it — `AGENTS.md` is governed surface.
- Whether the sibling repositories' seats hit the same pair. Not measured.

Refs: objectstack-ai/objectui#8471 (source, closed as moved) · objectui PR #8461 (`c90395b20`, the landed evidence) · objectui PR #8467 (the seat that wrote the model-free form) · #16807 (same class, this repo).
